title: Book: appendix of the EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans behind the SELECT claims
acceptance_criteria: Every measured SELECT claim (v6-sel-01..18) has at least one plan exhibit, or the appendix states why it has none
Plans are extracted mechanically by Go tooling from committed result JSON; each exhibit's run is one of the claim's registry anchors and sha256 of its result file equals that anchor's inputs_digest
The trimming rule is stated in the appendix; the full plan's location (results path and cell axis) is printed beside each exhibit
Plan-shape statements in reading notes are verified by the generator (expected same/different node tree), and the generated data is checked for staleness by go test
Registry validates with 0 errors; the canonical build verifies with every claim indexed; appendix pages are inspected
Merged into local main and tagged
expected_artifacts: exhibit spec and generated plan data
